CustomField.formula: HYPERLINK( "/lightning/r/" & IF( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Paid"), TEXT(YEAR(Payment_Date__c)) & RIGHT("0" & TEXT(MONTH(Payment_Date__c)), 2) & RIGHT("0" & TEXT(DAY(Payment_Date__c)), 2), IF( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Canceled"), "99999999", TEXT(YEAR(Scheduled_Date__c)) & RIGHT("0" & TEXT(MONTH(Scheduled_Date__c)), 2) & RIGHT("0" & TEXT(DAY(Scheduled_Date__c)), 2) ) ) & "/" & Id & "/view", IF( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Scheduled"), "Scheduled - " & TEXT(MONTH(Scheduled_Date__c)) & "/" & TEXT(DAY(Scheduled_Date__c)) & "/" & TEXT(YEAR(Scheduled_Date__c)), IF( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Paid"), "Paid - " & TEXT(MONTH(Payment_Date__c)) & "/" & TEXT(DAY(Payment_Date__c)) & "/" & TEXT(YEAR(Payment_Date__c)), IF( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Past Due"), "Past Due - " & TEXT(MONTH(Scheduled_Date__c)) & "/" & TEXT(DAY(Scheduled_Date__c)) & "/" & TEXT(YEAR(Scheduled_Date__c)), "Canceled" ) ) ), '_self' )
CustomField.label: Pledge Payment Name
